baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 2-7 joins belief, intentional work, the repeated ص ل ح quality, and causative entry into a human plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled assent becomes intended action characterized by repair rather than corruption; God then moves the actors inside the company characterized by that same repair.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inward commitment that the following work enacts.
Purposeful action turns assent into an operative deed rather than a bare label.
Repair opposed to corruption marks both the deeds and, by repetition, the destination company.
Movement into an inside gives the promise the force of actual admission, not mere resemblance.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive a favorable reward.
changed_reading.after: Belief enacted as repair culminates in God's actual admission of the actors into the company characterized by that repair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ص ل ح occurs first in the deeds at word 4 and again in the human plural at word 7, across لندخلنهم في.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root carries one quality from outputs to persons, while causative entry converts predication into social placement: what was done becomes the company in which the doers belong.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and aptness span the fitting deeds and the people fitted to the resulting company.
The image of a newcomer mixing with a group sharpens entry as incorporation among people.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds qualify their performers for an externally assigned category.
changed_reading.after: The repeated quality migrates from deed to actor and becomes durable belonging among people fitted to the same quality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ص ل ح pair at words 4 and 7 can carry the branch of removing estrangement, and في الصالحين makes its second occurrence collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the deeds are acts that remove aversion, admission among the صالحين can mean incorporation among people whose shared practice is relational repair.

activation_trace.role: Intended action keeps reconciliation tied to performed deeds rather than an abstract theme.
Removal of estrangement supplies a social-repair sense shared by the deeds and the cohort.
Admission supplies the transition from repairing action into a community of repairers.

changed_reading.before: The righteous are a generic class of morally good people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are a company constituted by acts that remove estrangement, into which the actors are admitted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening tests the spoken claim of belief, exposes fulfilled truth, and later contrasts it with a two-exit posture that changes allegiance under pressure. Entry among the صالحين therefore reads as a divinely disclosed membership after assay, not a self-certified identity.

activation_trace.role: Assent anchored in the heart is the focus claim whose durability is at issue.
Mixing into a group makes the result of disclosure a changed affiliation.
Assaying a human like material supplies the process that tests whether the claim holds.
Truth realized in promise and action supplies the positive result revealed by the assay.
A shown entrance with a hidden exit models the unstable affiliation contrasted with admitted membership.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 encloses the claim آمنا between testing and the disclosure of truthful and lying actors.
29:10-11 repeats the belief claim, depicts pressure-driven realignment, and then distinguishes believers from منافقين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, assay, disclosed truth, and unstable affiliation; I infer the arrow from those disclosures to the focus promise's group placement. A live alternative is that entry is only later reward and not the social result of testing.

changed_reading.before: Anyone described as believing and doing good is simply counted among the righteous.
changed_reading.after: The emphatic promise ratifies a membership that pressure has made real and distinguishable from verbal or reversible affiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-identical opening in 29:7 promises both erasure of bad effects and recompense by the best measure; 29:9 repeats the actors and deeds but changes the result to admission. The focus promise thus adds reconstitution of the person and their company to repair of the record.

activation_trace.role: The repeated repair-quality carries restoration from deed into personal and collective status.
Causative admission supplies the additional movement beyond accounting.
Covering that effaces sin supplies remediation of the negative record.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the transactional promise paired with admission.
The better or beautiful measure raises recompense above a bare one-for-one return.

structural_cues: 29:7 and 29:9 share the same faith-and-righteous-work opening and emphatic first-person plural futures.
29:7 names record repair and recompense, whereas 29:9 names entry into people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel subjects, formulas, and different promised predicates; I infer a movement from repaired record to reconstituted belonging. The alternatives are coordinate promises or stylistic variation without sequence.

changed_reading.before: Entry among the righteous is another wording for forgiveness or payment.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness and recompense do not exhaust the outcome: the focus adds transformation of status through incorporation among repaired people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, goodness toward parents remains binding while obedience stops where parents press for divine partnership; return and disclosure of work follow. The promised entry then supplies a non-genealogical affiliation ordered by fitting action without erasing care for biological kin.

activation_trace.role: Fitness supplies the criterion that orders deed and company when inherited claims conflict.
Mixing into another company activates the social force of the promise.
Parenthood by birth supplies the strong inherited bond that is retained but bounded.
Assigning partnership to God marks the point at which kin-directed compliance becomes misaligned.
Obedient yielding supplies the relation explicitly refused at that boundary.
Return supplies the final venue in which work and affiliation are disclosed.

structural_cues: 29:8 immediately precedes the focus and moves from parental goodness through coerced partnership to refused obedience.
The same ayah closes with return and notification of works before 29:9 promises entry among a new human plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded kin relation followed by divine return and then group entry; I infer that the focus reorders belonging around fitting action. The live alternative is a purely individual afterlife reward with no kinship contrast.

changed_reading.before: The صالحين are merely a moral rank added to a person without changing relational belonging.
changed_reading.after: Entry among them is a God-defined affiliation that can outrank coercive inherited loyalty while preserving rightly ordered care for kin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idol-based affection and connection collapse into mutual repudiation, the public way is cut, and later tightly wound dispute is constrained by what is better. These scenes activate the focus's reconciliation branch: صالح deeds maintain or restore relations and routes that false fellowship severs.

activation_trace.role: Removal of estrangement makes the repeated quality an active practice of social repair.
Group-mixing turns repaired relations into the constitution of a company.
Affection supplies the apparently cohesive bond whose false basis is later exposed.
The connection standing between parties supplies the relational structure that can hold or fail.
Road-severing supplies a concrete social mechanism of broken passage and predation.
Entwined contention supplies the conflict in which repair must operate.
Doing what is better supplies the governing action within dispute rather than mere victory over an opponent.

structural_cues: 29:25 moves from manufactured affection to reciprocal rejection and cursing.
29:29 joins cutting the road to public wrong, while 29:46 regulates argument by the better mode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed bonds, blocked routes, and disciplined dispute; I infer that the reconciliation branch of ص ل ح names the counter-practice and that its practitioners form the focus cohort. The alternative is that these are separate ethical examples and صالح remains generic.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are private merits that place similar individuals in one class.
changed_reading.after: They include work that repairs severed connective relations, so entry among the صالحين is incorporation into a community sustained by reconciliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later surah first places Abraham among the صالحين in the afterlife and then repeats the focus opening before promising an appointed abode and permanence. These echoes specify entry as both moral-social classification and enduring emplacement, without reducing either dimension to the other.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an inside is the focus motion later specified by abode imagery.
The repaired human company remains the direct object of belonging.
The same repaired-person category explicitly located in the afterlife supplies the temporal horizon.
Taking or assigning an abode supplies concrete settlement for the focus's entry.
Stable continuance resistant to ending supplies durability to the admitted state.

structural_cues: 29:27 uses من الصالحين after contrasting worldly reward with the afterlife.
29:58 repeats الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات and the emphatic promise form, then names lodging and permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated formulas, an afterlife occurrence of the cohort, abode, and permanence; I infer that the later promise retrospectively gives the focus entry locative and durable force. A live alternative keeps social admission and garden lodging as independent rewards.

changed_reading.before: Entry is an abstract verdict that assigns the label righteous.
changed_reading.after: It is at once enduring fellowship among repaired people and actual eschatological emplacement, with the social and spatial senses mutually sharpening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Corruptors are named by departure from صلاح and balance, while apparently beautified works can still turn people from the road. The surah therefore supplies an effects test for the focus adjective: صالح action repairs or maintains order and passage rather than merely appearing admirable.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work is the focus material whose result must be assessed.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the operative criterion for both deeds and people.
Departure from صلاح and balance supplies the explicit human opposite of the focus cohort.
Corrupting action in the land scales the opposite quality from persons to public effects.
Making something appear good supplies the deceptive surface that cannot certify a work as صالح.
Turning others away supplies the contrary effect produced by those beautified works.

structural_cues: 29:30 and 29:36 label people and public conduct by the explicit opposite of صلاح.
29:38 joins beautified أعمال to obstruction from the path even while their performers are perceptive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical opposite and a mismatch between attractive works and blocked passage; I infer consequences as a diagnostic arrow for صالح. The alternative treats صالح and فساد as conventional moral labels without this functional test.

changed_reading.before: Any well-intended or attractive work may count as one of the صالحات.
changed_reading.after: The adjective demands operative repair: deeds belong here when they resist corruption and preserve right passage, not when they only look good to their performers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a human cohort through the later spider-house image. It remains anchored in the focus's entry preposition, the group-mixing branch of د خ ل, and the reconciliation branch of ص ل ح, while 29:41 supplies patrons, dwelling, and weakness. Render it only as a relational-spatial analogy, not as an equation of the صالحين with a literal house.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لندخلنهم في الصالحين at words 5-7 permits the people entered among to function imaginatively as a lived relational inside.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an inside allows a human company to be read with restrained habitation imagery.
Reconciliation supplies the relational strength of the company entered.
Protective affection and alliance supply the social relation falsely sought in other patrons.
Dwelling and shelter supply the alternative container image against which human belonging can be read.
Loss of strength marks the failure of a shelter built from misdirected alliance.

changed_reading.before: Among the righteous denotes only placement on a list of people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is entry into a relational habitation whose repaired bonds contrast with the weakest shelter made by false patronage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading transfers the secure precinct of 29:67 to a social-moral company, so it is intentionally unusual. It remains anchored by the focus's ء م ن, causative entry, fitness branch, and the later ayah's deliberate recurrence of ء م ن for both security and belief amid snatching around. Render it as a spatial activation of belonging, not a claim that الصالحين lexically means sanctuary or guarantees worldly immunity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins heart-security at word 2 to entry at word 5 into a company fitted at words 4 and 7.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust provide the inward side of the focus's belief.
Causative movement inside supports a bounded-space analogy.
Fitness supplies the quality by which the admitted company coheres.
A protected spatial precinct supplies the outer image for contained belonging.
The shared root joins secure space and believing response within one context occurrence.
Rapid seizure outside supplies the threat against which secure belonging is perceived.
The surrounding region supplies the boundary contrast between precinct and exposure.

changed_reading.before: Belief and entry among the righteous are abstract inward and classificatory events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise images admission into a secure moral precinct of fitted people amid unstable allegiances and surrounding exposure.

strongest_changes: Membership is assayed and disclosed rather than established by saying that one believes.
The promise reorders affiliation across kin pressure and adds reconstituted belonging to pardon and recompense.
Later lodging and permanence make entry both communal and eschatological, while corruption and blocked-path scenes provide an effects test for صالح work.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah recurrence turns the compact promise into a hinge between tested identity, reordered belonging, social repair, and durable emplacement; the spider-house and secure-sanctuary scenes also activate contained spatial analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether في الصالحين foregrounds present affiliation, eschatological classification, or both remains open.
The reconciliation, habitation, and sanctuary readings are branch-led analogies and should not replace the ordinary moral sense.
The parallel promises support but do not require a strict temporal order from pardon to reconstitution to lodging.
